verse_part: so that they were in dread
and when he took it out,
and when he took it out
that they may celebrate a feast
“The honor is yours to tell me:
you would then have been cut off
I have allowed you to remain,
so that they let them have their request.
then you shall break its neck;
that you have taken us away
so that they will go in
those who rise up against You;
and he who had gathered little
then he shall let her be redeemed.
so that she gives birth prematurely,
for what has been torn to pieces.
then I will be an enemy
and I will completely destroy them.
so that they will drive out
and you will drive them out
that he may minister as priest
that he may minister as priest
the place where it is joined,
and offer them up in smoke
and offer them up in smoke
and from the one which was
that they may minister as priests
and that I may destroy them;
had let them get out of control
in order that He may bestow
and take us as Your own possession.”
and they would play the harlot
then you shall break its neck.
that he may minister as a priest
that they may minister as priests
